headline: Oil Rises 2.15 Percent To $102.05 As Money Moves Into The Energy Pipe
narrative: Oil rose 2.15 percent to $102.05, with money moving into the energy pipe. Gold fell 0.58 percent to $4,051 and silver fell 0.72 percent to $53.9, so the precious-metals pipe gave up ground as energy took the bid. Copper rose 0.57 percent to $6.66 and the S&P 500 rose 0.6 percent to 7,722.6, an industrial and equity bid running beside the oil move.
author: jordan
